name: Dark Tech
tagline: Midnight navy with cyan-indigo aurora glow, dot grid, gradient headline and serif-italic accents (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Deep navy field with cyan and indigo glow, white gradient type and a yellow spark
